versions.notes:
The first version that updates itself.
- The Atlaser.exe launcher, and a versions folder with one file per version.
- Versions and updates window: automatic updates, switching and deleting versions.
- A project in an older format asks before it is converted. A project from a newer version is greyed out in the list.
- A project can be pinned to a version of the app.
- A project is open in one window at a time.
